name: Roses (Spain)
description: White field charged with the three red roses of the arms, seeded yellow and barbed green, two above and one below.
history: The flag was approved on 22 September 1995 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 2115 of 16 November 1995; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, white, with the three red roses seeded yellow and barbed green of the arms, two in the upper half at 2/7 from the hoist and the fly and one below.

features.role: three roses seeded yellow and barbed green, set two and one
